ruleDefinitions.name: Disable Or Stop Services
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the usage of utilities such as 'systemctl', 'service'...etc to stop or disable tools and services

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/service$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/systemctl$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/chkconfig$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*stop.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*disable.*")))
